name: RAG-PDF-Chat-Multi-Agent-Pipeline--Python-React-FullStack
description: A full-stack RAG demo you can run locally or deploy to a VPS: upload a PDF, build a per-browser vector index (FAISS), chat with an LLM using retrieved context. The UI is a React + TypeScript SPA; the API is FastAPI + LangChain with a multi-agent pipeline, Sentry tunneling, & sensible production defaults (CORS, rate limits, session disk cleanup)

paragraphs: A production-style, educational full-stack RAG project that demonstrates how to turn PDF documents into searchable knowledge and chat with them using modern AI models. It is designed for learners and builders who want to understand document chunking, embeddings, vector search, SSE streaming responses, multi-provider model fallback, and practical deployment (Vercel + Coolify VPS) end to end.
features: Security: Private vulnerability reports — see SECURITY.md (contact@arnobmahmud.com)
